stage: qualification slice (stage 1), route A: sequential, checkpointed, one core per dataset
declared: 2026-10-02, R052; PROPOSED - runs only after Codex's review of this specification and the owner's go
purpose: measure the refit chain under the section 7.4 start policy on Lengau - per-resample time, the original fit, compilation, peak memory, utilisation - and prove checkpointed recovery across PBS jobs on an exact-index subchain; this slice reads NO coverage (no policy-matched reference exists yet) and produces no scientific row

datasets.seed_rule: simulate.dataset_seed(generator, grid, rep, D, seed_base) - fresh: seed_base 20261003 is disjoint from every historical seed (2026, 2027) and from the reference banks' seeds

cfg.note: B = 200 from the start: a changed B changes the identity, so no short-B timing run contributes; eight cold outer starts, four cold inner starts, plus every member's section 7.4 additions; M2S on its conservative interim (OPEN)

control.rule: the recovery control: dataset rep 0's resamples 0..19 under the UNCHANGED B = 200 identity, run once normally (job C1: segment 20, no interruption) and once under deliberate walltime interruption (job C2: a 20-minute walltime that the chain cannot finish, then job C3 resumes it to the segment); every completed scientific output of C1 and C3 compared field by field (rep index, chosen concepts, every predictor's band statistics, failed flags), timing and checksums excluded; then the resumed chain continues to 200 if the budget permits

code.commit: 103ee7f (RSC): the policy at 5f6333c + the refit slice hooks at ff82dd0 + the runner at 103ee7f; the Lustre clone rsc_slice carries them (policy branch + ff82dd0, 103ee7f, 9a6fbcc, ad0eb9f applied 2 Oct), its pinned file hashes verified equal to the four below
code.policy_config_hash: edcfdf4300f3 (D = 4, layer 41, seed 2026, refit, four inner cold starts; the slice's own hash is recomputed and recorded by the runner)

environment.toolchain: /mnt/lustre/users/pvanrooyen/t1_toolchain (t1py, t1site, rootfs python:3.12.10-slim-bookworm), clone rsc_slice (dedicated to this slice; never a tree another job uses)
environment.threads: NPROC=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1; no joblib workers (they cannot spawn under the image loader)

pbs.note: the runner stops dispatching new resamples 30 minutes before the walltime, finishes the resample in flight, flushes and exits 75 for resumption

templates.control: chpc/row19_slice_control.pbs.template (serial; C1 normal 48 h, C2 interrupted at a short walltime, C3 resume 48 h)

storage.checkpoints: <root>/ckpt (one fsynced JSONL per dataset identity, exclusive lock per writer)
storage.original_run_cache: <root>/orig (the original run_dataset outputs per dataset identity, so a resume never redoes the original fit)
storage.ledgers: <root>/budget.json (core-hours reserved and spent per job), <root>/timing_<rep>.jsonl (one line per resample), <root>/status_<rep>.json
storage.backup: pulled to RSC chpc/results/row19_slice/ by chpc-scp after every job (Lustre purges files older than 90 days and is not backed up)

budget.rule: before every submission: spent + the maximum remaining charge of live jobs + this job's walltime x cores <= cap, enforced by the runner's budget ledger at start (a job that would breach the cap exits 4 without running); on exhaustion the run stops and the incomplete report is retained; no automatic extension; nothing is reset

stops.identity: code hashes, environment versions and the dataset identity must equal the manifest's and the checkpoint's, else exit 4 (held)
stops.damage: strict restore: an unacceptable checkpoint record holds the run (exit 4) for diagnosis; only a trailing fragment is repaired
stops.deadline: no new resample after walltime - reserve; exit 75 (resume)
stops.budget: exit 4 before any fit when the cap would be breached
stops.second_writer: exit 4 when the dataset's checkpoint lock is held

measurements: the original run's seconds (once per dataset)
jit compilation seconds (the first fit of each member)
CPU seconds / wall seconds per job
resamples completed per job and across jobs
recovery: n_resumed, n_tail_repaired, n_damaged per start
not_in_this_slice: coverage against any reference (no policy-matched reference bank exists; the historical omega 1 reference is sensitivity evidence only)
any change to B, the policy, the seeds or the budget after submission
